facts.text: I want to learn how freshwater ecosystems such as rivers and lakes support biodiversity and human use.
I think freshwater ecosystems are important for both wildlife and humans.
I want to know what threats to freshwater ecosystems I should be aware of.
I want to know how I can personally help protect freshwater ecosystems from these threats.
I will try to be more mindful of my actions to help protect freshwater ecosystems.
I want recommendations for organizations that focus on freshwater conservation.
I want recommendations for volunteer opportunities with freshwater conservation organizations.
I am interested in habitat restoration volunteer opportunities.
I want to know whether I need any special skills to participate in habitat restoration volunteer opportunities.
I think I will start by conserving water in my household.
I think I will dispose of waste responsibly.
I think I will look into volunteering with one of the organizations mentioned.
